- x3 = rbind(toobject, I): function patch -> toobject(patch, I) returns object with grid colors.
- x4 = chain(leastcolor, x3, delta): for a patch, compute delta(patch) = bounding box minus patch indices, then toobject(delta, I) gives object with colors at those indices from grid, then leastcolor gives the least common color in that region.
